top_signals.title: SpaceX Seeks Approval for 32-Mile Florida Natural Gas Pipeline
top_signals.summary: SpaceX is seeking approval to build a 32.4-mile natural gas pipeline in Florida that would connect directly to the interstate gas network and supply the company’s expanding launch operations at Cape Canaveral. The proposed 16-inch pipeline would run through Brevard County and connect SpaceX operations directly to the Florida Gas Transmission system, giving the company a dedicated source of natural gas as its launch activity increases.
